// CASE key_from_const_one expect=fire
export async function keyFromConstOne(items, op) {
  const width = 1;
  await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency: width });
}

// CASE module_prefix_const_min expect=fire
export async function modulePrefixConstMin(items, op, n) {
  const width = Math.min(1, n);
  await lib.mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE module_prefix_let_min expect=fire
export async function modulePrefixLetMin(items, op, n) {
  let width = Math.min(1, n);
  await lib.mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE local_options_from_const_one expect=fire
export async function localOptionsFromConstOne(items, op) {
  const width = 1;
  const options = { concurrency: width };
  await mapLimit(items, op, options);
}
